links.outcome: ASR word error rate variation across patient subgroups (country of birth, positive symptom severity)
links.effect: WER ranged from 0.31 to 0.58 across 50 samples, with systematic variations by country of birth and severity of positive symptoms.
links.quote: Different WER showed systematic variations based on country of birth and severity of positive symptoms.
